description: This file defines a React component 'ErrorPage' that renders an error page with dynamic content based on URL parameters and error types. It handles verification of signed parameters and displays different back navigation links depending on error context.

classes.name: ErrorPage
classes.description: A React component that displays an error page with context-specific messages and navigation links.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Sets the body class to 'sticky error' when the component mounts.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Removes the 'class' attribute from the body when the component unmounts.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the error page UI based on URL parameters and error type, including verification of signed parameters.
